| # Integration of Routine Control in ASW {#integration-of-routine-control-in-asw-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                         |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Example:

A Routine Control with ID 0x0201 must be created to initiate the routine.\
This routine requires a Routine Control Option (input) record of 24 bits and returns a Routine Status (output) record of 8 bits.

In easyConfig we need to do following configuration for above mentioned example:

1.In Routine Control configuration page in easyConfig need to provide following information.

  Parameter Type       Description
  -------------------- --------------------
  Routine Name         Routine_ASW_Demo
  Routine Identifier   0x0201
  Routine Type         Start
  Callback             Routine_start_0201
  IN Signal Length     24
  OUT Signal Length    8

   

Note: IN Signal Length and OUT Signal Length is variable length.\
 i.e for above example maximum routine control option length(Input) is 24 bit.\
 UDS will accept the request if routine control option length is less that 24 bits but not more than 24 bits.\
 If requested a service with more than 24 bits will get negative response.\
 Similarly for OUT Signal  maximum it can send in response is 8 bit.

2\.  Routine Callback has to be defined in ASW for performing the routine start functionality

   For callback registered in eC config the function definition will be generated in \"bds_diag_appl_adapt.c\" file.

 

3\. Request and Response

- UDS Request message for Example Routine

  ------------ ----------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------ ------------------------ ------------------------
  Service ID   Sub Function ID   Routine Identifier(MSB)   Routine Identifier(LSB)   Routine Control Byte 1   Routine Control Byte 2   Routine Control Byte 3
  0x31         0x01              0x02                      0x01                        0x10                   0x11                     0x12
  ------------ ----------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------ ------------------------ ------------------------

 

- UDS Response (Positive response)

  -------------------------------- ---------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- -----------------------
  Respose ID for Routine Control   Routine Control Type   Routine Identifier(MSB)   Routine Identifier(LSB)   Routine Status Byte 1
  0x71                             0x01                   0x02                      0x01                        0x20
  -------------------------------- ---------------------- ------------------------- ------------------------- -----------------------
